title: The Hollow Wolf Revisited
premise: When the border wards collapse and the stars vanish in a single night, Xanthe Marchetti learns that the Thornfell mountains were never a country at all—they are the body of a sleeping wolf-god, and its keepers have finally stopped feeding it. Hunted by wardens who blame hedge-witches for the fall, Xanthe must guide a ragged band of survivors along smuggler roads to the Hollow Door, the only exit from a land being devoured by darkness. Along the way they discover their missing mistress, Vessa, helped break the wards to free the wolf, forcing Xanthe to choose between loyalty to her and truth for the people relying on them. In the end, Xanthe opens the Door not as an escape but as a wound that lets starlight back in—sealing it from the inside, at the cost of never leaving.
about_author: Quentin Quintana is the pen name of a former trail-guide who spent six years mapping forgotten passes through the Carpathian foothills before turning to fantasy. They write stories about borders, both real and imagined, from a cabin with more maps than furniture.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Xanthe, hiding in a smuggler's waystation after fleeing their apprenticeship, watches the stars extinguish and feels the mountain shudder as the border wards fail. Wardens arrive hunting witches, and Xanthe barely escapes with a wounded stranger, Odile, who carries a map fragment to something called the Hollow Door. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: terror and the bitter realization that invisibility is over.

chapters.title: Roads That Remember
chapters.summary: Guiding Odile and gathered refugees through smuggler tunnels, Xanthe finds waymarkers keyed to their own blood—proof Vessa built these paths into the wolf-god's body long ago. A warden ambush reveals the wardens serve the keepers who starved the god deliberately. POV: Xanthe, with interludes of Odile's journal. Emotional beat: rising dread as loyalty to Vessa begins to crack against mounting evidence.

chapters.title: What Vessa Buried
chapters.summary: At the Hollow Door's antechamber, Xanthe confronts Vessa herself, who confesses she broke the wards to wake the wolf and end the keepers' stolen rule—even if the land dies waking. Refugees begin vanishing into the dark outside; Odile is revealed as a keeper's daughter seeking redemption. POV: alternating Xanthe and Odile. Emotional beat: betrayal, grief, and the climax choice between Vessa's cause and the truth.

chapters.title: The Door Out of Nowhere
chapters.summary: Xanthe rejects both Vessa's sacrifice and the keepers' law, cutting their palm on the Door's hinge-stone so it opens onto starlight rather than escape. The wolf-god stirs, fed at last by truth freely given, and the stars return—but the Door seals with Xanthe on the wrong side, keeper of the passage forever. POV: Xanthe. Emotional beat: sorrowful resolution—justice outside the law, paid for in exile.
